real_browser.scope: Actual Chrome/Pyodide integrations. Short tests do not assert 72-hour performance or physical-iPhone completeness.

operator_case.scope: Fixed-flux conservative shaft operator; not a full weather-process comparison.

inflow_regression_cases: Northward material outflow with the source jet overtaking the storm: zero permitted regeneration inflow, Astra and Sol.
Zero or purely tangential system-relative source flow stays blocked.
Friction-slowed bottom layer cannot replace the mass-weighted source-layer wind.
Vector rotation leaves permitted inflow invariant.
Valid eastward leading-head inflow remains positive.
A thicker real moist-source layer raises the finite flux, bounded by donor air/water, not a rainfall floor.
limitations: No guarantee that all composite-reflectivity cores or all stations receive 10-20 mm in five minutes.
All 32 major gauges are retained, including weak-rain and unfinished cases.
Coarse Sol rain quadrature is not newly resolved small-scale atmospheric dynamics.
No default 6-km or natural 72-hour full Astra process run in this delivery.
This is a reduced model, not an operational 3-D forecast.
